text: This report provides a status update on the Islington Village Planning Framework (the Planning Framework), including information on its draft area of focus, scope, phasing, and timing. Through the Planning Framework, Staff will be engaging with the local community and Ward Councillors to review the existing policies, strategies, and guidelines applicable to Islington Village (the Village) to identify opportunities to reinforce the area's main street character. The Planning Framework will focus on the pedestrian-oriented character of the Village, streetscape and public realm improvements, and opportunities for placemaking that enhance this character, while accounting for new Provincial direction for increased density around delineated Protected Major Transit Station Areas (PMTSA). A report with final recommendations is targeted for Q2 2027.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Received the report (June 15, 2026) from the Director, Community Planning, Etobicoke York District for information.
